run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T15:38:19Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is explained by repeated OOM kills of the cart service's Redis backend. Deployment valkey-cart (namespace otel-demo) runs one replica of valkey/valkey:8.1.3-alpine with a 10Mi memory limit (request 4Mi); its pod valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft is not ready, has restartCount 4, its last container termination is OOMKilled with exit code 137 at 15:41:18Z, and the container is now in CrashLoopBackOff. The pod's cgroup memory max-usage reached 10,493,952 bytes, above the 10,485,760-byte (10Mi) limit, and the valkey-cart Service has no ready endpoint addresses. Because Redis was unavailable, cart logged 'Wasn't able to connect to redis' from 15:39:40Z onward and produced its own error spans on CartService/GetCart, AddItem and EmptyCart; checkout produced error spans on its CartService/EmptyCart and GetCart calls and on CheckoutService/PlaceOrder. Frontend span error rate, zero in the returned samples from 15:14:19Z to 15:36:19Z, first became non-zero at 15:38:19Z and peaked at 3.0222222222222217 spans/s at 15:42:19Z - exactly the value in the alert annotation - with errors concentrated on frontend's client spans to CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its /api/cart routes. Nodes report no MemoryPressure, so the kill is attributable to the pod's own 10Mi limit rather than node pressure.

claims.text: Frontend span error rate was 0 in the returned samples from 15:14:19Z through 15:36:19Z, then 0.089 at 15:38:19Z, 0.267 at 15:40:19Z, 3.0222222222222217 at 15:42:19Z, 0.659 at 15:44:19Z and 0.933 at 15:46:19Z; the 15:42:19Z value equals the 'current' value 3.0222222222222217 in the alert annotation.

Frontend's own error spans in the window are concentrated on dependency calls: grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 85.38, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem 122.98, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 32.52, POST /api/cart 151.44, GET /api/cart 56.92, executing api route (pages) /api/cart 208.36, POST /api/checkout 32.52 and executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 32.52 error spans (increase over 4727s), while no errors were returned for /api/products, /api/recommendations or /api/data.

Cart's own spans show errors on POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (103.94 ERROR vs 5919.97 UNSET), POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem (124.75 ERROR vs 3205.70 UNSET) and POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (1.125 ERROR vs 1051.97 UNSET), while its Redis operation spans HGET, HMSET and EXPIRE carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Cart's application log contains the line 'Wasn't able to connect to redis' repeatedly, beginning no later than 15:39:40.238Z (6 matching lines inside 15:38:20Z-15:40:00Z) and continuing through 15:45:42Z, interleaved with normal GetCartAsync/AddItemAsync calls.

Pod valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft (otel-demo) has container valkey-cart not ready, restartCount 4, state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff ('back-off 1m20s restarting failed container=valkey-cart'), and lastState terminated reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137, startedAt 15:41:07Z, finishedAt 15:41:18Z; its container resources are limits cpu 10m / memory 10Mi and requests cpu 2m / memory 4Mi.

Deployment valkey-cart (otel-demo) declares 1 replica and its pod template container valkey-cart uses image valkey/valkey:8.1.3-alpine with resources limits cpu 10m / memory 10Mi and requests cpu 2m / memory 4Mi; it has no ready replicas. Pod valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft is owned by ReplicaSet valkey-cart-58df56c79c, which is controller-owned by Deployment valkey-cart.

The pod-level cgroup container_memory_max_usage_bytes for valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft reached 10,493,952 bytes over the window, above the container's 10Mi (10,485,760 byte) memory limit; the individual container generations peaked at 3,153,920-5,582,848 bytes.
Service endpoints for valkey-cart in otel-demo list no ready addresses for port 6379 (only notReadyAddresses 100.96.5.138), while the cart Service has a ready address 100.96.5.38:8080.

Kubernetes events for valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft include BackOff reason 'Back-off restarting failed container valkey-cart' with count 22 at 15:45:35Z, alongside Created/Started events at 15:42:51-15:42:53Z (count 6 each).

Checkout has its own error spans on oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (17.6 ERROR vs 1073.31 UNSET), oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (1.125 ERROR) and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (31.9 ERROR vs 1058.07 UNSET), plus 14.3 HTTP POST errors.

valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft is the only otel-demo pod with a non-zero restart count (4) or a non-Running-ready state; the other 20 pods, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-x9gbm and cart-755465879b-4p8d9, are Running and ready with 0 restarts. All pods show startTime between 15:00:39Z and 15:02:28Z.

All five cluster nodes report condition MemoryPressure status False (reason KubeletHasSufficientMemory), including i-0d211959f7bf532cd where the valkey-cart pod runs, so node-level memory pressure is not indicated.
frontend-proxy has its own error spans on operation 'ingress' (580.21 ERROR vs 20501.42 UNSET) and 'router frontend egress' (58.94 ERROR vs 21024.73 UNSET) in the window.

Error spans by service over the window: frontend 782.62, frontend-proxy 639.15, cart 229.82, checkout 64.93, fraud-detection 3.05, recommendation 3.05, ad 2.04, accounting 0, payment 0; the ad, fraud-detection and recommendation errors are all on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream spans, not on cart or checkout calls.

Primary causal chain: valkey-cart's 10Mi container memory limit is too small for valkey's working set, so the container is repeatedly OOM-killed (exit 137, 4 restarts, CrashLoopBackOff, no ready endpoints on Service valkey-cart); cart cannot reach Redis ('Wasn't able to connect to redis') and returns gRPC errors on GetCart/AddItem/EmptyCart; checkout then fails on its cart calls and PlaceOrder; frontend's client calls to cart and checkout and its /api/cart routes fail, which raises frontend's request error rate to the 3.02 spans/s seen in the alert.

Node-level memory pressure is not the trigger: every node, including the node running valkey-cart (i-0d211959f7bf532cd), reports MemoryPressure False, and no other otel-demo pod has restarted (all restart counts 0), which points to the pod's own 10Mi limit rather than a node-wide or namespace-wide condition.

Frontend itself being down or misconfigured is not the source of its errors: frontend-675fd7b5c5-x9gbm is Running and ready with 0 restarts and emitted spans throughout the window, and the frontend error spans fall on outbound CartService/CheckoutService calls and /api/cart routes rather than being the only failing operations.

The small error counts on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation are not part of this incident: they are entirely on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (flagd streaming) spans, not on cart, checkout or frontend request paths.

frontend-proxy's error spans (580.21 on 'ingress', 58.94 on 'router frontend egress') are plausibly the proxy observation of the same failing frontend responses (roughly 2.8% and 0.3% of its spans), but no trace-level linkage or HTTP status code was observed, so this attribution remains unverified.

Raise the valkey-cart container memory limit above 10Mi (and/or configure a valkey maxmemory policy consistent with that limit) so the Redis backing store stops being OOM-killed, then confirm the pod reaches Ready and Service valkey-cart regains a ready endpoint; also add an alert on valkey-cart restarts/OOMKills since the current alert only surfaced the symptom at frontend.

gaps: The Alertmanager/Prometheus alert rule for RequestErrorRate was not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no_data, and a query for alert rules with severity=warning also returned no_data, so the rule expression and evaluation window are unknown (the annotation value 3.0222 does match the frontend span error-rate sample at 15:42:19Z).

change_history is not integrated, so it cannot be verified when or why the valkey-cart 10Mi memory limit was set, nor whether the environment-wide pod start times of 15:00:39Z-15:02:28Z represent a rollout that introduced it.

Trace-level detail for the failing requests is missing: traces_search for frontend over 14:38:19Z-15:57:06Z exceeded the view size and its sample came from ~15:17Z (before error onset), traces_search for 15:41:00Z-15:44:00Z returned no traces, and traces_search_by_tags with error=true / otel.status_code=ERROR returned nothing, so no parent-child edge or HTTP status code could be confirmed.
Container valkey-cart produced no log output (0 lines read, previous instance unavailable), so the Redis-side reason for the memory growth beyond 'OOMKilled' cannot be read.
The frontend container returned 0 log lines in 15:38:00Z-15:46:00Z, so no application-level error message from frontend itself was observed.

kube-state-metrics series (e.g. kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total) were not present in the queried Prometheus, so the exact times of the earlier OOM terminations could not be reconstructed; only cadvisor container series and the current pod status were available.
Whether frontend-proxy's ingress error spans correspond to the same failed requests is unverified.

The container_memory_failcnt / container_memory_failures_total series for valkey-cart show 0 for oom-type counters (only pgfault/pgmajfault series exist), so the OOM is evidenced by the pod's lastState OOMKilled/exit 137 and the cgroup max-usage vs limit, not by those counters.
next_steps: Inspect the valkey-cart Deployment values/overlays (e.g. Helm values or kustomize patch) in change history to confirm whether the 10Mi memory limit was set or lowered recently.
Review valkey memory usage and maxmemory policy for the cart dataset, and right-size the limit with headroom rather than 10Mi.
Confirm on the Alertmanager side which expression produces RequestErrorRate and whether other services' alerts fired in the same interval.
After the fix, verify valkey-cart becomes Ready, Service valkey-cart has a ready endpoint, and frontend/cart/checkout error spans return to zero over a comparable window.
